entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.>> O God, thou [art] my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is; {thirsty: Heb. weary} {where...: without water}

words.text: , when he was in the wilderness

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: To see thy power and thy glory, so [as] I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: ¶Because thy lovingkindness [is] better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul shall be satisfied as [with] marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise [thee] with joyful lips: {marrow: Heb. fatness}

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: When I remember thee upon my bed, [and] meditate on thee in the [night] watches.

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: ¶Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those [that] seek my soul, to destroy [it], shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes. {They shall fall...: Heb. They shall make him run out like water by the hands of}

words.text: . {They shall fall...: Heb. They shall make him run out like water by the hands of}

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
